
To address the first issue, I’ll reduce the overall strength of the water color contribution from `0.22` down to something like `0.10`. This will make the specular highlight appear only on the more sharply angled surfaces, reducing the wash of brightness across the whole surface.

For the foam, I’ll move the `smoothstep` range upward: from `0.10–0.5` to `0.18–0.65`. This will suppress foam in gentle regions while still allowing it to appear on steeper, more turbulent parts, giving a more natural white‑water look.
